summary: The change satisfies every clause of the contract: ProfileContent uses the shared fictional baby with bundled assets, all membership/capacity/cloud-storage copy was removed with tests asserting its absence, a labelled role=switch reminder control is provided, the profile links to /me/baby, and logout is gated behind an accessible confirmation modal before routing to /login. EditBabyContent provides labelled controls with inline validation, an onSave callback navigating to /me, and explicit local-demo privacy text. Evidence confirms no upload, persistence, paid-storage promise, or remote request, so no real family data is at risk. All gates are green: TDD red-to-green cycle documented, 23/23 regression tests, tsc --noEmit, Vite production build, and scoped Biome. No P0 concerns: data is fictional, there is no real authentication surface, and there is no destructive, networked, or supply-chain behavior. Only minor follow-ups around test-assertion transparency and modal keyboard coverage.
